decisions.title: P7 implementation authorised
decisions.decision: P7 implementation is authorised within the named scope; nothing beyond.
authorised_scope: project-local persistent memory layout and schema (G1)
documentation and validators to verify those three deliverables
rollback/removal mechanisms per the P7 threat model
explicitly_forbidden: installing dependencies, packages, skills, MCPs, CLIs, or tools

governance.G1: Memory format: JSON with documented, machine-validatable schema. Deterministic, inspectable project-local files.
governance.G2: Memory location: sps2/ subtree, outside sps2/core/. Not inside the adapter/core surface.
governance.G3: Isolation: no shared persistent state, no cross-project imports, no cross-project registry/state references. Mechanically provable.
governance.G4: Team bootstrap: mechanical checklist from repository state and authoritative sources. No unnecessary generated runtime state.
governance.G5: Global-memory retirement: inventory first. No legacy modification. Stop if broader boundary needed.
governance.G6: P2 SUBSTANTIALLY_SATISFIED is sufficient under D-P7-A.
governance.G7: P7 has its own explicit User authorisation; does not inherit from P3.
governance.G8: CONF-001 remains UNRESOLVED. No LCP/INP introduction.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'I explicitly authorise Roadmap P7 implementation.' with G1-G8 resolved.

what_these_decisions_do_not_authorise: any action outside the named scope
